resolved_findings.finding: The feature table originally included vendor suffixes even though the Cogl loader appends them.
resolved_findings.resolution: Unsuffixed eglGetSyncValues and eglGetMscRate declarations now resolve to the exact CHROMIUM and ANGLE symbols. Independently checked against the 48.7 resolver.

resolved_findings.finding: The void parent swap interface hid EGL_FALSE, allowing a later swap to incorrectly confirm a failed frame.
resolved_findings.resolution: A private checked helper returns the actual EGLBoolean from both swap paths. Xlib submission failure disables tracking and drains symbolically without increasing target SBC.

resolved_findings.finding: Explicit swap_region calls could bypass counting while automatic notifications were suppressed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Normal swap-region features are disabled. Explicit calls disable tracking and queue ordered symbolic notifications without assuming an SBC increment.

resolved_findings.finding: An identity mismatch could allow later frames in the same poll batch to be confirmed.
resolved_findings.resolution: The finishing function returns the identity result; polling stops confirmation and drains symbolically on mismatch.

resolved_findings.finding: A refresh rate queried only at initialization can become stale.
resolved_findings.resolution: Completed batches query the rate again. Query failure sets rate to zero instead of reusing an old value.

positive_checks: Disabled by default; explicit COGL_EGL_X11_SBC_FEEDBACK=1 and both extension features are required.
Per-surface submitted/completed SBC is tracked. UST is not attributed to submitted frames; presentation_time_us stays zero, with HW_CLOCK, VSYNC and zero-copy flags cleared.
Notifications retain references and use existing Cogl dispatch, without direct user callbacks from the timer.
Pending metadata is bounded. Overflow, counter reset, query failure and deadline expiry fall back to symbolic notifications. Dispose removes timer/metadata before the base frame queue is cleaned.
Optional trace is disabled by default and limits periodic summaries; it does not print each frame.
Independent extraction reproduced all three tested fragments/harness byte for byte; replayed patch hashes match all eight final tree files.
Observed 17 cases using actual candidate functions with mocked boundaries: -Wall -Wextra -Werror and ASan/UBSan passed, including the checked EGL swap helper.
limits: This is not a full Mutter build, linked ABI validation or live compositor test.
Mocked EGL/Cogl boundaries cannot establish actual GPU-driver, event-loop or physical-display behavior.
The 250 ms deadline is a soft polling deadline and cannot interrupt a blocking EGL/driver call.
SBC confirms swap completion, not a physical presentation timestamp, vsync or zero-copy.
The reviewer did not build Mutter, install system files, restart the compositor or operate the board.
